title: Consolidated Press Holdings Limited and Illyria Nominees Television Pty Limited - acquisition of shares in Ten Network Holdings Limited

timeline.event: CPH (via Cavalane) acquired a 17.88% shareholding in Ten.
ACCC commenced a review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Illyria purchased 50% of CPH's shareholding in Ten.

The ACCC announced that there was not sufficient information available at this time to establish a breach of section 50 of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010. The ACCC will continue to monitor future developments at Ten having regard to the competition provisions of the Act.
